newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Zeus jumps 16.82 pct on buy-in rumour.
newsitem.headline: Zeus jumps 16.82 pct on buy-in rumour.

text.p: Zeus Holdings Inc, a new holding company, jumped by 16.82 percent to 2.50 pesos by midsession on Monday on the Philippine Stock Exchange, brokers said.
One broker said some buyers might be just punting the issue on rumours that a foreign company was planning to buy into the company. Company officials were not available to comment.
Zeus recently converted itself into a holding company. It used to be JR Garments which ceased to operate on August 30.
